text: The crime wave is coordinated. Someone is directing it to create a pretext
A guard captain is on the payroll of the criminal network
Those who would take the law into their own hands have picked out a culprit on bad information
A household woke to find its door forced and nothing taken, and wants to know what the thieves were looking for
A boy who runs errands for half the place has started carrying more coin than any errand pays
Those who talk of taking the law into their own hands meet tonight, and they want someone who can fight
A household robbed in the night swears the robber knew which chest held the money
A stallholder at the market has stopped reporting thefts, and will not say why
A watchman afraid of the night round is looking for someone to walk it with him, and will pay from his own purse
A shopkeeper has been told to close by the end of the week, by people who did not give their names
Two crews have been seen arguing over the same ground, and a fight between them looks a night away
A thief caught in the act is being held in a cellar by the household that caught him, and nobody knows what to do with him next
A cart left loaded overnight was emptied before dawn, and the carter wants to know who was awake
An old woman's savings have gone from under her floor, and only her family knew where they were kept
A pedlar is selling goods cheap that several households swear were taken from them
Chalk marks have appeared on several doors overnight, and the households behind them are frightened
A guild master's records have gone missing ahead of an audit
A journeyman denied mastership has proof the exam was rigged
Someone is sabotaging both sides to destabilize the market for a third party
A trader selling outside the rules has had a cart overturned in the night, and has a fair idea who did it
A craftsman working from home has been told to stop selling, and means to carry on
Both sides of the quarrel over trade are counting heads before the next gathering, and each is a few short
A family that sells to both sides is being pressed to choose, and has asked for a few more days
A stall at the market has been promised to two traders at once, and both will turn up at dawn
The guild is about to fine a member for buying from an outsider, and the member has threatened to name who else does it
A trader turned away from selling is taking the matter to the court, and needs a witness who saw it
A boat's cargo sits unloaded at the water's edge while the two sides argue over who may sell it
A trader outside the guild has been offered protection by people outside the law, and is tempted
An apprentice has run from one side of the quarrel to the other, and taken a master's tools along
A craftsman has made goods for a trader who is not allowed to sell them, and wants paying regardless
A trader at the market has been selling under the agreed price, and a crowd is expected at the stall tomorrow
A guild master has quietly bought from a trader outside the guild, and someone saw it happen
A store of the scarce goods is being kept off the market on purpose
The scarcity was engineered. Someone destroyed the competing supply route
An alternative source exists but the information is being suppressed
A household caught hoarding is about to be turned out by its neighbours, and swears it was keeping the goods for others
A carter offers to fetch what is short from elsewhere, if someone will pay half the price before he sets out
A family that cannot pay the prices asked is selling its last good tools to buy what it needs
With the place going hungry, a sack of food has gone missing from a household that had little to spare
A party sent to take supplies for the war is due tomorrow, and households are hiding what they can
A boat has come in loaded with what is short, and its master is asking twice what anyone here can pay
The threat is being exaggerated by someone who profits from selling to the fearful
A way to come to terms exists, and those who want a fight are keeping it quiet
The threat has an agent already inside the settlement
A rider brings fresh news of the danger tonight, and it does not match what the last one said
A family is packing to leave before dawn, and the neighbours are trying to stop them spreading panic
Someone nobody here knows has been asking about the paths in and out, and has asked for a bed for the night
A stretch of the wall has been found crumbling, and mending it needs more hands than there are
Those who keep order are calling for volunteers, and the first to come forward is the last one anyone expected
Tracks of the beasts that press on this place have been found beside a well-used path, closer than ever
A would-be heir approaches outsiders to investigate a rival's past
The ailing ruler wants a final errand completed before naming a successor
Someone is poisoning the ruler slowly, and someone in the household knows
One of the would-be successors is giving a feast tonight, and every guest will be counted
A would-be successor wants a rival's supporters watched, quietly, and is offering coin for it
A letter meant for one would-be successor has reached another, and both now know what it says
A household that has backed no one is visited by each side in turn, and has asked for protection from both
A council member has not yet said whom they back, and their house was broken into last night
With the seat empty, the seal used on the place's business has gone missing
The original loan documents contain a clause that was never disclosed publicly
A creditor's agent is in town conducting a quiet assessment before enforcement
The debt could be voided, if someone can prove it was obtained through fraud
The one who kept the accounts of the loans has gone missing a week before the collectors are due
A family that would bear the cost is quietly moving its goods out of the place, cart by cart
The outside power has sent word of the day it will collect, and wants to know who will meet its people
The creditors have taken a household's goods against the debt, and the household wants them back before they leave
A wealthy household offers to pay the debt itself, in return for a say in how the place is run
A trader at the market is selling off stock cheap before the collectors arrive, and seems to know the day
A document that would settle the question of legitimacy exists, and both sides would rather it stayed lost
Those in power are paying people to speak for them at the gatherings, because no one will do it for free
A third party is keeping the question open on purpose, because an unsettled claim is easier to bargain with
Someone has painted a challenge to the authority's right to rule where everyone will see it at dawn, and those in charge want the hand found
A speaker who questions the right to rule is due at a gathering tonight, and those in charge mean to stop the gathering
One of those who deny the mandate has been offered a post by those in charge, and has not yet answered
Those risen against the authority have seized a store of supplies, and the keeper of it is missing
A preacher of the new faith is telling crowds that those in charge rule without blessing
The investigator who uncovered the corruption has received a death threat
A key witness can be found, but won't speak without protection
The corruption goes higher than anyone yet suspects; those pressing to expose it are being used
A copy of the evidence is being passed from hand to hand, and one copy differs from the rest
An official named in the evidence is selling property in a hurry
Someone has offered to buy the evidence outright, for more than it seems worth
The hearing on the evidence is set for next week, and the clerk who was to read it out has fallen ill
One of those who betrayed the place is named in the evidence, under another name
A trader who paid dues to the corrupt has kept every receipt, and is deciding whom to give them to
